cap:info.cap:headline: Thunderstorm Alert: Northern Ghana to Experience Moderate to Heavy Rain This Evening
cap:info.cap:description: A moderate to heavy thunderstorm system moving westward from northern Benin is expected to impact northern Ghana this evening. The storm will bring varying intensities of rainfall, accompanied by thunder and strong winds to the Upper East, Northeast, and Northern regions between 4:30 PM and 9:00 PM today. The Upper West and Savannah regions should prepare for similar weather conditions following the initial impact areas.
cap:info.cap:instruction: Residents in this region should avoid outdoor activities in the evening. During the thunderstorm, stay indoors and away from windows, unplug electrical appliances to prevent damage from lightning strikes, and avoid using corded phones or electrical devices connected to outlets. If caught outdoors, seek substantial shelter immediately. Drivers should exercise extreme caution by reducing speed, using headlights for visibility, and avoiding flooded sections of roadway
